name: Grok CLI (superagent-ai)
disclaimer: Written from the documented interface and, where the README is silent, the source; not verified against an install. Flags drift; correct and open a PR.
notes: A community project; its README says it is not affiliated with xAI (npm grok-dev). --model is defined in src/index.ts and absent from the README, which names GROK_MODEL instead; the session store is read from src/storage/db.ts.

options.trust_none_why: No documented read-only or tool-less mode; --sandbox isolates a run in a microVM but does not stop it writing. Ineligible for the reviewer role until one exists.

transcript.access: READ-ONLY. A second writer corrupts the agent's own state.
